name: Runemaster Hurricane plays the client's custom wind animation (#7717)
contract: #7717: a Spirit Mage (class 32, the Runemaster) reports Hurricane 645435 with no animation, and the
recording linked in the report shows the ability wrapped in a wind storm. The client owns the spell's
authored visual: SpellVisual 1816 (shared only with the Wildcard Runic Hurricane pair 280930/280932), whose
casting kit 2941 ends on world effect 310142, a row that exists in no archive of the client - the row was
missing on Ascension as well, where the same client played the ability correctly, so the missing row is not
what renders it. What carries the wind is the helper visual Ascension authored next to it: SpellVisual 1817
owns no spell at all and its casting kit 2944 attaches the custom wind effect SPELLS\shaman_unleashedwind_01
- a client-owned asset that no other visual plays. The live servers stream that kit to the client when the
Runemaster casts Hurricane; this repository's server never did, which is why the caster showed only the
spell's hand and impact effects. The fix plays the client's own kit 2944 on the caster in
opcode 499) - the mechanism the Templar and Necromancer abilities in this repository already use - and leaves
the client's Spell.dbc rows untouched. That packet is a core opcode, which the harness does not record, so this
scenario proves the spell still works and that no client row is overridden; the appearance itself is a client
test. The Wildcard sibling 280930 is out of this issue's scope. The spell must still work: the cast applies
the 2 s Hurricane aura and its strike deals damage.

steps.label: Let spawn AI, level scaling and the login patch stream settle

Casting Hurricane is what streams the wind kit to the client
REALITY: Hurricane still applies its aura
